storefront.description: The web frontend users talk to; it calls catalog, cart and checkout

cart.description: Shopping cart service and its session store

checkout.description: Order placement service; it calls orders-db and the payments provider

orders-db.description: The orders database: replication, failover, connections, data volumes, and its batch jobs

payments-provider.description: The external payments API the shop depends on; not operated by us

cluster-platform.description: Kubernetes itself: nodes, scheduling, disks, node OS, monitoring

network.description: DNS, ingress, load balancers, certificates, links to other networks

causes.out-of-memory: A process exceeded its memory limit and was killed
causes.bad-config-or-deploy: A recent release, config edit or credential rotation broke it
causes.dependency-down: This component is healthy but something it depends on is failing
causes.network-connectivity: Packets are not getting through: loss, timeouts, disconnects
causes.disk-pressure: A disk or volume is full, filling up, or too slow
causes.certificate-expiry: A TLS certificate is expiring or failed to renew
causes.load-spike: More traffic than the current capacity can serve
causes.hardware-fault: A node or device has a hardware fault
causes.transient-noise: Self-resolved, expected, or harmless; nothing to fix

severity: Page now: outage or data at risk
